request: Share Spykar blog topics from April through October 2026 and create fresh October topics without duplication.

sources.finding: The tracker contains topic blocks for April through October 2026. No spreadsheet mutation was requested after the user clarified that 'remove' meant 'share'.
Existing coverage already includes broad festive outfit ideas, dressy festive denim, festival-to-afterparty dressing, shirt-and-jeans styling, men's black-jeans looks, and Navratri styling.
Sharad Navratri 2026 runs from October 11 to 19, followed by Dussehra on October 20; the proposed set therefore focuses on distinct festive-use cases plus evergreen fit and care gaps.
